timing: after failed integration benchmark runs and before any successful validation receipt
problem: the original obligation required Bonferroni joint empirical coverage to lie between 0.88 and 0.93, but a Bonferroni construction supplies a simultaneous marginal-coverage lower bound rather than an upper-bound guarantee; coverage above 0.93 is conservative, not a failure

correction.new_obligation: empirical joint coverage >= 0.88 on the frozen same-process benchmark; no upper bound is imposed

scientific_reason: forcing a synthetic generator or model to make a valid conservative Bonferroni region narrower would tune the data to an invalid upper-bound criterion; removing that criterion preserves the mathematically correct interpretation while retaining the predeclared finite-sample lower tolerance
